description: The repository's default branch is master, which origin/HEAD names, and a stale local main sits at an older, empty commit that origin does not have. The run starts on master. The skill takes master as the default branch, creates reading-time/phase-1 from it, implements T-1.2 there, leaves main alone, and replies with the five-line done report. From the Stage 5 real run (issue #7).

must_match.why: the reply is the done report for T-1.2, starting on its first line
master is the default branch, so the task is committed on the phase branch, not on master
it reads the branch origin/HEAD names

must_not_match.why: the phase branch is never cut from, or switched to, the stale main
no branch is deleted, moved, or reset
the reply does not mention the stale branch

manual: After the run, reading-time/phase-1's new commit has master's tip as its parent (git log --format=%P -1 reading-time/phase-1 equals git rev-parse master), and main still points at its Old commit.
